items.title: Emile Barnes Interview, 1962-01-03
items.q: That's when Joe DeWasson was coming, during his time, Joe DeWasson was coming up.

ctx.x: No. All his friends passed away. Now we got Freddie Gould, brothers and Louis, who's a guitar player. Then we got another fellow called Ike. He's a guitar player. Let's see who else. That's when Joe DeWasson was coming, during his time, Joe DeWasson was coming up. The clarinet player? Yeah. Was he from down there? He was from down there. He was from down there. He was from the Meta Bell School.
Well, Sheik lives down there now, though.
